title: Split .ai into context-bound plug-in modules

costar.context: Chats, schemas, skills, plans, and the roadmap were split by file type under .ai/schema, .ai/skills, and .ai/data.
costar.objective: Make each context one folder that carries its skill, schema, and data, discovered from module.json with no central registry.
costar.style: One folder per context, shared checker only.
costar.audience: The next coding agent and the maintainer.
costar.response: Five modules under .ai/modules, a self-test that a temporary sixth module is picked up, and organize.py --check exiting 0.

concerns: A checker with the module list hardcoded would still force an edit to add a context. The self-test plugs in _probe and then deletes it.
Cursor skill junctions under .cursor/skills are local. The canonical skill is the SKILL.md inside the module.
This move does not finish the engine build and does not add a license validator.
context: The previous operating plan filed chats into one data tree. The user asked for context-bound, plug-and-play folders.
current_state: modules/chats, journal, plans, roadmap, and costar each have module.json and SKILL.md. The checker walks .ai/modules.
target_design: Adding a context is adding .ai/modules/<id>/ with module.json and SKILL.md. The shared machine does not gain a line for that id.
changes: Move schemas and data into the module that owns them.
boundaries: Do not mint an enterprise license key.
Do not mark the build phase done.
Do not merge the journal back into the chat transcript.

verification.name: temporary-module-is-discovered
verification.proves: A folder added under .ai/modules is checked without editing the checker, a bad journal type is rejected, and the filed chats still match their schemas.

verification.name: unchanged-sync-and-five-modules
verification.proves: Unchanged transcripts add no events, and the real tree is exactly the five modules.
verification.expected: sync events 0 and skipped 4; check modules 5
